name: SQL Query
description: Runs one read-only SELECT/WITH query over the connected input tables. Each connected input is exposed under its source node id (quote it: FROM "1:1"); 'inputs' may rename a subset of the connected inputs. The output schema is read with SELECT * FROM (<sql>) LIMIT 0; LIST, STRUCT, MAP and TIMESTAMPTZ columns are rejected. DDL/DML (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, DROP, ALTER, ATTACH, DETACH, COPY, INSTALL, LOAD, PRAGMA, SET, EXPORT, IMPORT, CALL) and multiple statements are rejected before the query runs; the result is capped by 'limit'.

sql.title: SQL
sql.description: One read-only SELECT or WITH statement over the tables named by 'inputs'.
sql.placeholder: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM src GROUP BY category

inputs.title: Input tables
inputs.description: Optional table names for the connected inputs: a source node id or a free alias assigned in port order. Omit to expose every connected input under its node id; naming a subset exposes only those tables.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum number of rows the node returns; 10000 by default, at most 1000000.
